answer: With a Phone SIM bound by one-time code delivery with a public binding record, the account is only as strong as its binding: the phone sim answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. One voyage proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of bindings. Whether the proof comes from a canyon or a shale, the verification step is identical and public.
